scheme_name: Safai Karmakar Bahay Rogi Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Must be a registered unorganized worker of the State Social Security Board
Family members must be mentioned in the registration card
Benefits are available only to the Safai worker and the listed family members (husband, wife, son, daughter)
Benefit is limited to a maximum of two children per family
If the beneficiary is receiving assistance from any other parallel state scheme, they are not eligible for this scheme
benefits_summary: Medical assistance up to Rs. 2,000 per year.
